# Fonts for Egypt redesign

The requested Kaftan Serif is by Victor Bartis. Its official page states that the demo is for trying out (non-commercial use), and sells a separate Web License. No Kaftan binary has been downloaded.

- Official Kaftan source: https://www.victorbartis.com/kaftan-serif
- Official Web License store: https://victor-bartis.gumroad.com/l/egNbV

Selected legally embeddable fallback: **Bodoni Moda**, by Owen Earl / Indestructible Type. This is not Kaftan, but provides a high-contrast elegant display serif with a similar ceremonial direction.

- Bodoni Moda official Google Fonts repository: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/bodonimoda
- Onest official Google Fonts repository: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/onest

Both downloaded families are supplied under the SIL Open Font License 1.1; their respective license files are included. Original unmodified variable TTF files are retained.

WOFF2 Latin and Latin Extended subsets were downloaded from the official Google Fonts CSS API and fonts.gstatic.com. `fonts.css` includes all subset unicode ranges and local relative filenames. Full TTF originals remain available if required.
